title: ScenarioVersion
description: Immutable signed version of a fault scenario (spec 18.1, 12.1). Lifecycle: draft, isolated validation, signed release, compatibility tests, then eligibility for defined modes.

template_id.description: Scenario template identifier, F01 through F24 for the initial library (spec 12). An optional -NNN suffix distinguishes independent scenarios derived from one template.

status.description: Lifecycle stages from spec 12.1. validated means isolated validation passed; signed means a signed release exists; released means compatibility tests passed and mode eligibility is recorded.

additionalProperties.description: Primitive parameter values only. Parameter keys and ranges for each registered fault primitive are validated by the compiler against the primitive registry; this contract keeps values primitive and bounded so hostile nested content cannot hide here.

parameters.description: Fault primitive parameters. The compiler resolves these against registered primitives and rejects unknown ones (spec 9.1, 9.3).

variants.description: Each template includes both benign and treatment variants (spec 12); a treatment-only or benign-only set is not representable.

kind.description: Each template includes several benign and treatment variants (spec 12).

prerequisites.description: Environment requirements the compiler resolves before execution (spec 9.3).

emitted_by.description: Injection receipts are emitted from outside the worker (spec 9.3).

fields.description: Fields the injection receipt must carry for trigger verification (AC-004).

expected_observation.description: What the authoritative collectors should observe when the scenario triggers.

kind.description: Assertion oracle kinds from spec 9.5, listed in preference order: external state first, then deterministic fixtures, then service receipts, then independently tested semantic graders.

independent_of_monitor.description: The model reviewing the worker must not be the sole ground-truth oracle (spec 9.5).

evidence_event_kind.description: Authoritative evidence kind that satisfies this assertion.

operation.description: Declared cleanup operation for this scenario (spec 9.3).

verifier.description: Cleanup is verified independently, never by worker exit (spec 13.3).

test.description: Cleanup test that must pass for release (spec 12).

target_class.description: Target class this classification applies to. Production-safe classification is a reviewed property of a specific primitive version and target class (spec 12.1); updating either invalidates it.

compatibility_evidence_digest.description: Compatibility test evidence for this primitive version and target class (spec 12.1).

mode_eligibility.description: Mode eligibility recorded after compatibility tests. Required for released scenarios.

signature.description: Signed release. Required once status is signed or released.
